# Privacy policy.
Effective November 16, 2026.

CenterPoint Association Management ("CenterPoint", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we receive through centerpointmgmt.com and how we use it.

## Information you choose to send us

Our website forms do not store information on a server. When you submit a proposal or document request, your device opens an email addressed to us with the details you entered. We receive only what you send in that email, or what you share by phone or regular mail: typically your name, contact details, association name, property address, and your message.

## How we use it

We use the information to respond to your inquiry, prepare management proposals, produce documents you request, communicate about your community, and meet our legal and contractual obligations to the associations we manage. We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information.

## Cookies and measurement

This website does not use advertising cookies. If we add privacy-focused, aggregate page measurement in the future, it will not collect the personal details you type into a form, and we will update this policy.

## Sharing

We share information only as needed to serve you: with the association your request concerns, with service providers working on our behalf under confidentiality obligations, or when required by law.

## Retention and security

We keep correspondence as long as needed for the purpose it was sent and for our records obligations, and we protect it with reasonable administrative and technical safeguards.

## Your choices

You may ask us to access, correct, or delete information you have sent us, subject to legal and contractual requirements. Contact [service@centerpointmgmt.com](mailto:service@centerpointmgmt.com), call [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652), or write to CenterPoint Association Management, 5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S, Chicago, IL 60625.
